advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 9/15 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 15.70; 6/6 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.661 over 15 corners (10 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Fronts lock first: brake balance 2-4% rearward.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 0.19 vs R 0.07; 5/12 stops

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 24 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.73) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 12 stops (2 both-axle, 5 front-first, 1 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
